policy: Five exact pre-existing CL2 physical sites with Phase27M research certificates and contemporaneous first-party operator named-chapel page and district listing.
All claims are source-published patterns, NOT confirmed dated Mass occurrences. No RRULE expansion, Sunday-to-holiday assumption, or weekday-from-unspecified inference.
The Gniezno first Thursday and preceding first Friday Thursday are a single time-of-day row representing two potentially overlapping conditional descriptions.
The 2026-11-07 Łódź notice supersedes the former first-Saturday time with 10:00; older operator district print snippets can be stale.
Katowice 08:30 'suma' is NOT asserted to mean exactly Sung Mass in the app. Krosno late-night first-Friday Communion/adoration is NOT a Mass.
Other 2026 documented source conflicts (Białystok, Bielsko-Biała, Bolesławiec, Bydgoszcz, Kielce, Jarosław, Kalisz) are excluded pending exact source reconciliation.
No Una Cum, missal edition, canonical status, ownership, celebrant, precise GPS entrance or live availability inferred.

entries.exception_en: First Friday only; not every Friday.
entries.exception_fr: Premier vendredi uniquement ; pas tous les vendredis.

entries.exception_en: First Saturday only; not every Saturday.
entries.exception_fr: Premier samedi uniquement ; pas tous les samedis.

entries.label_en: First Thursdays or Thursday before first Friday
entries.label_fr: Premiers jeudis ou jeudi précédant le premier vendredi
entries.exception_en: The operator lists both first Thursdays and Thursdays immediately preceding first Fridays at 18:00. When both conditions describe the same date, this is one time, not two Masses. Verify locally.
entries.exception_fr: La source indique 18h00 à la fois les premiers jeudis et les jeudis précédant le premier vendredi. Si les deux conditions tombent le même jour, il s'agit d'un seul horaire, non de deux messes. Vérifier localement.

entries.exception_en: The source calls this a 'suma'; its precise musical form is not independently classified.
entries.exception_fr: La source indique « suma » ; la forme musicale précise n'est pas classée indépendamment.

entries.exception_en: The detailed chapel programme specifies remaining Saturdays, not first Saturdays.
entries.exception_fr: Le programme détaillé de la chapelle précise les autres samedis, hors premiers samedis.

entries.exception_en: First Saturday replaces the usual other-Saturday pattern; check local notices.
entries.exception_fr: Le premier samedi a un horaire distinct des autres samedis ; vérifier les annonces locales.

sites.physical_description: St. Stanislaus Kostka chapel, ul. Żeglarska 6

entries.exception_en: A first-Saturday 11:15 Mass is also published; verify whether 18:00 is maintained on those dates.
entries.exception_fr: Une messe est aussi annoncée le premier samedi à 11h15 ; vérifier si l'horaire de 18h00 est maintenu ces jours-là.
